ex.note: Quad Focused, Keep Legs Straight and try to keep feet as deep as you can. Try to keep pressure on the inside "Big Toe" of foot.
Don't be afraid to engage your core to stabilize and keep the tension on your glutes/hams

ss.note: Short Stride for Quads, think knee forward and keep pressure on inner part of foot.
Think of lowering with back leg to extend/stretch glute, then push with front foot through heel to come back up.
